scientific_integrity: Exact limiting variance derived by pairwise inclusion-exclusion and uniform asymptotic summation; Gaussian limit invokes the pre-existing joint protected-node CLT, not a new independent CLT proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the uniform recursive tree and zero leaf degree. No finite-size closed variance of the undirected statistic, no multivariate all-degree limit, no claim of independently certified priority.
title: Exact zero-leaf-degree variance in random recursive trees
